thread:
nora: Quick follow-up from design review — noticed inconsistent lexicon between sidebar, help panel, and KB. Sidebar says 'Guides', panel says 'Docs', KB articles are titled 'Playbook'. Users get lost. Screenshot attached. ryan: Yep ran into this in support. When people search for 'playbook' in-panel they get zero results. The global docs search matches, so definitely an index mismatch. ana: Accessibility/UX idea: instead of renaming everything immediately, surface a small inline hint under the panel header: 'Also known as: Playbook, Runbook' so users see terms. Could be transcluded from doc frontmatter. ux-research: We have interview notes where participants used 'playbook' 70% of the time for runbooks. Suggest canonicalizing on 'Playbook' in user-facing labels and adding aliases. nora: I prefer 'Guides' as umbrella term, then use 'Playbook' for operational runbooks. Proposed header: 'In-product guides (quick links)' with a tiny sublabel: 'Includes Playbooks — full docs link below'. ryan: Implementation notes: panel search uses a lightweight lunr index built from frontmatter.title + frontmatter.aliases. Docs team can add aliases in YAML. Example frontmatter snippet I tested:```--- title: "Playbook: Incident Response" aliases: ["runbook","play books","incident playbook"] ---``` docs-bot: Indexer note — aliases are normalized (lowercase, punctuation stripped). Add semicolon-separated aliases in the CSV migration or YAML in new docs and the in-panel search will pick them up on next rebuild. ana: Accessibility: please ensure the header link has role="link" and aria-describedby pointing to the subtitle. Also autofocus search input when panel opens and trap focus inside modal. I'll add to the checklist. ryan: Analytics: add event `help_panel_open` with property `term_searched` so we can see which words users try first (playbook vs guide vs runbook). Also add utm=help-panel to full docs CTA to separate traffic. nora: Action items: (1) docs team to add aliases to frontmatter for top 25 KB pages (2) frontend to change header label to 'In-product guides' + sublabel, header links to /docs/guides and is clickable (3) small UX hint listing common synonyms (transcluded) (4) accessibility tweaks from ana (5) analytics event for searches. docs-bot: I'll create a tracking ticket for index migration and add a note to the KB migration guide about aliases. ana: I'll draft the ARIA and focus snippet in PR, e.g.:```html
In-product guides

Quick links — includes Playbooks

``` ryan: I'll coordinate with docs for the frontmatter updates and add the analytics props. ETA for patch release: two weeks. nora: Thanks — will add these to the release board and loop in legal for any doc title changes. :thumbsup:
